episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Tony's cantankerous funk -- which he calls a superpower -- is taking a toll on his co-workers. Meanwhile, a new writer starts at The Tambury Gazette.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Thinking he has nothing to lose, Tony contemplates trying heroin. He babysits his nephew and starts to bond -- just a bit -- with Sandy.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Tony hires a sex worker -- but it's not what you think. A trip to the comedy club turns awkward. The nurse gives Tony a piece of her mind.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Tony pushes back on Matt's idea to go on a blind date. Also, Tony makes an introduction and issues an uncharacteristic apology.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Brian (finally) convinces Tony and company to visit his apartment for a story. Meanwhile, Matt receives a distressing call from his son's school.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Making an earnest attempt to be happy -- or at least not miserable -- Tony gives some long overdue recognition to those who have stood by him.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Determined to be kind but still struggling to be happy, Tony attends a Zen meditation course with Matt, whose own marriage is on the rocks.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Lenny's girlfriend's son takes a position at the Gazette. Sandy contemplates writing a gossip column. Matt gets iffy advice from his therapist.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A turn of events at the paper hits Sandy hard. Roxy and Pat share a meal, and Tony tries to support Matt's desire to get back out there.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Tony interviews a local woman addicted to corrective surgery. Later, he holds back the snark in hopes of cheering up Kath.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The curtains go up on the community theater revue and things go about as well as can be expected. Tony receives devastating news.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Grieving over another loss, Tony asks his friends and co-workers for space, not sympathy. Later, he wrestles with what it means to move on.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Tony, who continues to keep Emma at arm's length, reluctantly agrees to go to Matt's house for a round of drinks. Brian bumps into a familiar face.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The Tambury Gazette welcomes a gloomy new staffer. Meanwhile, Kath visits a psychic, and a restless James makes plans for his future.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Tony takes a trip with Matt to honor his father. James has second thoughts about his new living arrangements. Tony helps Kath score a date.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Matt searches for a sport at which he can beat Tony, Lenny asks Tony to be his best man, and Kath has dinner with a persnickety teacher.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Anne gives Tony some advice on moving forward, Emma crosses paths with an old friend, Matt suffers a health scare, and James stands up for himself.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: An interview with a sick child hits Tony hard. Later, he makes a decision about Lisa's insurance money and joins his friends at the town fair.
